### 1. Square Root Transformation
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)

birds <- c(22,28,37,34,13,24,39,5,33,32)
mean_birds <- mean(birds)

birds_t <- sqrt(birds)
mean_birds_t <- mean(birds_t)

# Inverse transformation
mean_birds_to <- (mean_birds_t)^2
birds_o <- (birds_t)^2
mean_birds_o <- mean(birds_o)
```

### 2. Logarithmic Transformation
```{r}
mydata <- c(12,19,0,15,145,0,32,5,17)
mean_o <- mean(mydata)

log10mydata <- log10(mydata + 1)
mean_t <- mean(log10mydata)

# Inverse transformation
mydata_O10 <- (10^(log10mydata) - 1)
```

### 3. Arcsine Transformation
```{r}
x <- c(0.25, 0.31, 0.21, 0.24, 0.3, 0.29, 0.22)
xt <- asin(sqrt(x)) * 180 / pi
x_O <- sin((xt) / 180 * pi)^2
```

### 4. Box-Cox Transformation
```{r fig.height=7}
library(MASS)

trat <- rep(1:5, each=6)
repet <- rep(1:6, 5)
resp <- c(2370,1687,2592,2283,2910,
          3020,1282,1527,871,1025,
          825,920,562,321,636,317,
          485,842,173,127,132,150,
          129,227,193,71,82,62,96,44)
data <- data.frame(trat, repet, resp)

fit1 <- aov(resp ~ factor(trat), data=data)
anova(fit1)

# QQ Plot
qqnorm(data$resp)
qqline(data$resp, col=2)
```


```{r fig.height=7}
# Box-Cox estimation
bc <- boxcox(resp ~ trat, data = data, plotit = TRUE)
lambda <- bc$x[which.max(bc$y)]

data$resp_boxcox <- if (lambda == 0) log(data$resp) else (data$resp^lambda - 1)/lambda
```


```{r fig.height=7}
data_long <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(resp, resp_boxcox), names_to = "method", values_to = "values")

data_long <- data_long %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  mutate(scaled_values = scale(values)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(data_long, aes(x = scaled_values, fill = method)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4, position = "identity") +
  labs(x = "Scaled values",
       y = "Freq.") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("red", "limegreen"), labels = c("Before", "After"))+
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```
